title: Sammaciccia's guess about SS eugenics programs continued after the war
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Sammaciccia's guess about SS eugenics programs continued after the war, about WWII to 1950s at Underground facilities (Europe), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: point it occurred to me that the SS were involved in eugenics programs and there were rumors that after the war these uh eugenics programs were continued in secret in underground facilities

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, talking on a podcast with host Jesse Michels and discussing a man named Bruno Sammaciccia, says it struck him that the SS, the Nazi party's elite military and police force, ran eugenics programmes, meaning efforts to breed people for chosen traits. He says there were rumours that after the Second World War these programmes carried on in secret in underground facilities in Europe. If true, it would mean Nazi breeding experiments outlived the war in hidden places.
